description: Check a Graph Paper plot document and return the link that opens it. The link opens the plot as an editable draft in Graph Paper (https://graph-paper.io); the reader needs no account. Give the document as a JSON object in the format of get_plot_format. If the document has errors, the result lists each one with the path of the field and what to change, and no link; fix them and call the tool again. Warnings name the keys that were ignored.

document.description: The plot document: a JSON object with at least "title" and "series". See get_plot_format and list_examples.

name: make_plot_link

path.description: The field, in JSON path notation such as "series[0].fn"; empty for the whole document.

note.description: With ok true: the formulas were not computed, and what to ask the person when a row does not work.

ok.description: True when the document is valid and url is given.

rows.description: How many rows of each kind the document has.

url.description: The link that opens the document.

path.description: The field, in JSON path notation such as "series[0].fn"; empty for the whole document.

title: Make a Graph Paper link
